What is a Customer Data Platform and why is it important for marketing?

A Customer Data Platform (CDP) unifies customer data from every channel, website, email, app, and in-store, into a single, actionable view of each customer. This makes it possible to build precise audiences, personalise every touchpoint, and know which customers are worth prioritising, rather than treating every customer the same.

Raptor unifies data from every channel a customer interacts with, then uses it to power real-time product recommendations on your website and in every email. Rather than showing every customer the same generic bestsellers, Raptor recommends what's actually relevant to each individual, based on their own behaviour and purchase history.
Single Customer View, unifying all customer data and behaviour into one profile.
Audience Builder, combining any data source into precise, ready-to-use audiences.
Website and Email Recommendations, personalising product suggestions for each customer.
Email marketing platforms

Once ingested, the CDP unifies this data into a single customer profile per individual — connecting anonymous behavior with known user data across sessions and devices. From there, you can build audiences, calculate attributes, and activate segments across all your channels.

The Raptor CDP is channel-agnostic. It does not replace your existing marketing tools — it connects to them and gives you the data layer needed to target the right customer, in the right channel, at the right time.
